channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Devin Booker | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Devin Booker from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Tim Kawakami on Devin Booker
item.description:
According to seasoned Warriors and Bay Area reporter Tim Kawakami, the Dubs are ready to surrender tons of assets that would let them have the Phoenix Suns star.

“I think the Warriors like him too much, if you ask me. But they love him. Steve loves him. Booker loved playing for Steve,”

Tim Kawakami on Devin Booker, Sep 12, 2026. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Mat Ishbia on Devin Booker
item.description:
Suns owner Mat Ishbia:

“I’ll ride into a fire with Devin Booker, and I’ll do it proudly… Devin Booker is not getting traded. Devin Booker is our franchise player. We’re going to win a championship here with Devin Booker. I’m excited to do it and be next to him when we do that.”

Mat Ishbia on Devin Booker, Apr 30, 2026. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Jordan Ott on Devin Booker, Jalen Green
item.description:
UPDATE: Jordan Ott on Devin Booker (right ankle sprain) and Jalen Green (right hamstring injury management and left hip contusion):

“Book is making tremendous progress. Obviously been on the court multiple times. Trending in a good spot and Jalen, it's just the fall. The hamstring seemed to be good. Everything was good until that fall. We're going to be smart here. Everyone saw the fall and how hard it was. Mechanically, we want everything to be right. His back to be feeling right, his hip to be feeling right, but it appears to be everything was good with the comeback on the hamstring.”

Jordan Ott on Devin Booker, Jalen Green, Feb 1, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jordan Ott on Devin Booker
item.description:
Jordan Ott on Devin Booker (left ankle sprain) OUT at Pistons:

“The swelling is there. Think he's been through this before. He's able to return as quick as possible. If he could go, he could, especially being here in Michigan. We're going to try to get it next game.”

Jordan Ott on Devin Booker, Jan 15, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Devin Booker
item.description:
Heat coach Erik Spoelstra on Devin Booker:

“I love Book. I love what he's all about. I think what he's doing this year probably speaks to his desire to win and do whatever is necessary to win as much as any other year. He's doing a lot of role player stuff. You would think coming into this year without the big names. In September, people probably thought he would have to score 30+ a game, but he's embraced the team and I think he's probably fed a bunch of life and confidence into the roster.”

Erik Spoelstra on Devin Booker, Jan 13, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Tre Johnson on Devin Booker
item.description:
Wizards guardTre Johnson on comparisons to Devin Booker:

“I wouldn't say I want that as a comparison. I really don't want any comparison to a player to be honest,but I feel like there are things going back and watching the film, there are things I can get from the game cause he got to the free throw line quite a bit, especially with aggressive defense and that's probably something I'm going to start seeing. Guys having their hands on me a little bit today. So I think there are things I could watch for sure.”

Tre Johnson on Devin Booker, Dec 30, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jordan Ott on Devin Booker
item.description:
Suns coach Jordan Ott on Devin Booker (right groin strain):

“He did practice with us. It’s always a good sign. Now we’ll see how he responds from this. It’s probably the most he’s done. See exactly where he’s at, but everything seems to be progressing.”

Jordan Ott on Devin Booker, Dec 12, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jordan Ott on Devin Booker
item.description:
Suns coach Jordan Ott on Devin Booker (right groin strain) as far as possibly playing Wednesday at OKC in NBA Cup quarterfinals:

“He's been able to get on the court the last couple of days. Continue to assess to see exactly how he feels after tonight after that initial early session and then we'll see on Wednesday.”

Jordan Ott on Devin Booker, Dec 8, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: David Fizdale on Devin Booker
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't: David Fizdale on Devin Booker:

“Just being there with him, the conversations we had about how much he cares about the community how much he loves playing there...it's a mutual love affair. I am going out on a ledge right now he's gonna have a statue in Phoenix”

David Fizdale on Devin Booker, Nov 8, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mat Ishbia on Devin Booker
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't: Ishbia:

“Devin Booker is the franchise player, he's one of the greatest Suns of all time. He wants to be here just like we want him here, and that's what a great marriage looks like. I'm a lucky guy to own a team and be the leader of a team that has Devin Booker”

Mat Ishbia on Devin Booker, Sep 24, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Devin Booker
item.description:
podcast,Lue believes the new Clippers guard was overshadowed playing alongside Devin Booker and Kevin Durant in Phoenix.

“When you play for a team like Phoenix like he did the last couple of years, you got Booker and KD and you’re the third option,”

Tyronn Lue on Devin Booker, Aug 28, 2025. Source: Arizona Republic.

item.title: Brian Gregory on Devin Booker
item.description:
GM Brian Gregory:

“Devin Booker is the embodiment of the Phoenix Suns,representing the best of our organization, our community and our future.”

Brian Gregory on Devin Booker, Jul 10, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Oso Ighodaro on Devin Booker
item.description:
Oso Ighodaro on Devin Booker's scoring:

“There's a lot of narrative about, 'Oh, he's playmaking'...He's been super aggressive looking to score and teams weren't blitzing him, teams weren't hard-hedging, so I don't think that's an intentional shift. I think he just reads the game”

Oso Ighodaro on Devin Booker, Apr 8, 2025. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Devin Booker
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:Kevin Durant on Devin Booker's playmaking lately:

“I just think he's seeing the floor at an all-time rate where the game is slowing down,he's seeing stuff before it opens up.... That's just an experience thing, it's a confidence thing”

Kevin Durant on Devin Booker, Mar 26, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Tyus Jones on Devin Booker
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:Tyus Jones on Devin Booker saying the Suns have put him in a tough spot:

“Depending on kind of where we're at in the season, it's been a little different. He also knows who I am as a player and where I thrive. So yeah, to hear that, it means a lot to me, him having my back.”

Tyus Jones on Devin Booker, Mar 1, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Mike Budenholzer on Devin Booker
item.description:
Mike Budenholzer on @ChrisBHaynes' reporting on meeting with Devin Booker:

“His communication is awesome.... There’s conversations that Devin and I have all the time, and I’m good with those conversations. We don’t always agree on everything. I think he actually appreciates it.”

Mike Budenholzer on Devin Booker, Feb 28, 2025. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Mike Budenholzer on Devin Booker
item.description:
Mike Budenholzer on Devin Booker's All-Star case:

“Book's one of the great 2-guards in our league right now. What he's done this season as a scorer, as a playmaker, as a leader, he's clearly in our minds an All-Star. Hopefully the other coaches see and respect what he's done”

Mike Budenholzer on Devin Booker, Jan 30, 2025. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Tyus Jones on Kevin Durant, Devin Booker
item.description:
“Just being ready to shoot, honestly. Being ready to make defenses pay. They're showing a lot of crowds to (Devin Booker and Kevin Durant).Playing a little more off the ball, screening a little bit more. Just doing whatever is asked of me.”

Tyus Jones on Kevin Durant, Devin Booker, Jan 10, 2025. Source: Twitter @DuaneRankin.

item.title: Mike Budenholzer on Devin Booker
item.description:
Mike Budenholzer on Devin Booker's progress:

“Similar answer to the other day, he's making good progress. We feel good about it. He's still got a little bit more to go.”

Mike Budenholzer on Devin Booker, Dec 27, 2024. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Devin Booker
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:Steve Kerr on how Devin Booker impressed him in the Olympics:

“It's not easy for a guy to adapt his normal role of go-to-guy, scorer and then to be asked to be a defender,connector and then thrive in that role, and then become a star when we needed him to become a star”

Steve Kerr on Devin Booker, Nov 30, 2024. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Mat Ishbia on Kevin Durant, Devin Booker
item.description:
Mat Ishbia:

“When I traded for Kevin Durant, it was a no-brainer. A thousand times out of a thousand, you make that trade. You get Kevin Durant on your team with three and a half years left on his contract from the time I traded for him, and you put him next to Devin Booker, and you go play. AndI feel great about the trade then. I feel better about it even now. It's been a great thing for our organization, and I can’t wait to see it come to fruition the way we all envision it.”

Mat Ishbia on Kevin Durant, Devin Booker, Nov 20, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Devin Booker
item.description:
“Devin Booker is an incredible basketball player. Nobody asked about him. He was our unsung MVP. I just wanted to say that,”

Steve Kerr on Devin Booker, Nov 20, 2024. Source: Andscape.

item.title: Reggie Miller on Kevin Durant, Bradley Beal, Devin Booker
item.description:
“Whenever you have Kevin Durant and Devin Booker, and then you add Bradley Beal, hopefully he can be healthy for 65, 70 games, you always have a puncher’s chance,”

Reggie Miller on Kevin Durant, Bradley Beal, Devin Booker, Oct 17, 2024. Source: Arizona Republic.

item.title: Monte Morris on Devin Booker
item.description:
Monte Morris on Devin Booker:

“He’s bringing that [Team] USA dog in here, especially getting after it on the defensive end. I think y’all are gonna see a lot of that this year.”

Monte Morris on Devin Booker, Oct 15, 2024. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: LeBron James on Jrue Holiday, Devin Booker, Anthony Edwards, Tyrese Haliburton
item.description:
LeBron on Anthony Edwards:

“That was the best thing about our team. You know, we had the vets—myself, Steph, KD, AD, Jrue Holiday—and then you had the younger guys, Tyrese Haliburton, Anthony Edwards, Devin Booker. Just to see the excitement that Ant-Man played with, showed off the floor, he wanted to compete against everybody. You probably saw him want to compete versus the Team USA ping pong team. He said he could beat people in swimming, you know. He wanted to compete versus everybody. And just to see that electric and that energy from the young guy, and for us as the older guys remembering at one point having all that energy, it was definitely a blessing for sure to be around.”

LeBron James on Jrue Holiday, Devin Booker, Anthony Edwards, Tyrese Haliburton, Sep 21, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Charles Barkley on Kevin Durant, Draymond Green, Devin Booker
item.description:
Charles Barkley:

“I don’t think Kevin Durant wants to be a leader. He just wants to play basketball, and that’s fine, but somebody on that team has to step up and be the leader. It worked in Golden State because they had Steph Curry and Draymond Green to lead. But in Phoenix, someone needs to take that role, and in my opinion, it has to be Devin Booker. You can’t have a team without a leader. Kevin just wants to hoop, and that’s fine, but Devin has to take on that leadership role if they want to win a championship.”

Charles Barkley on Kevin Durant, Draymond Green, Devin Booker, Sep 10, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Anthony Edwards on LeBron James, Kevin Durant, Stephen Curry, Devin Booker
item.description:
Whyba: Anthony Edwards:

“Stephen Curry had great games, he (Kevin Durant) had great games, Lebron James had great games, but Devin Booker was guarding the best player, turning down shots, Book go for seventy, not gonna lie, I was impressed watching him.”

Anthony Edwards on LeBron James, Kevin Durant, Stephen Curry, Devin Booker, Aug 18, 2024. Source: x.com.

item.title: Dalton Knecht on Devin Booker
item.description:
Dalton Knecht:

“I’d say I play a similar game to – not at his star level – Devin Booker. Throughout college, I think I played like him. I don’t know, just not as good as him.”

Dalton Knecht on Devin Booker, May 21, 2024. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Chris Finch on Devin Booker
item.description:
Timberwolves coach Chris Finch on the challenge of stopping Devin Booker:

“He’s such an explosive player….we’re lucky enough to have a few guys to throw at him, but again, you don’t really stop these guys. You just gotta try to keep ‘em from hurting you time and time again.”

Chris Finch on Devin Booker, Apr 23, 2024. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Devin Booker
item.description:
Frank Vogel on Devin Booker’s 5-for-16 shooting night in Game 1:

“The Phoenix Suns are a team, it's not about one player. I'm not worried about him getting going, he's one of the best scorers in the league. We'll do a better job of looking at ways to free him up”

Frank Vogel on Devin Booker, Apr 20, 2024. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.
